def validate_selection(extracted,row,page_count):
    from . import runtime as r
    p=r.load_pipeline()
    from .source_repairs import reconstruct_missing_selection
    result=reconstruct_missing_selection(extracted,page_count)
    selected=result.get('scopeSelection',{})
    p.require(isinstance(selected,dict) and isinstance(selected.get('text'),str) and selected['text'].strip(),'Thiếu phạm vi cụ thể đã chọn')
    sections=selected.get('sections');excluded=selected.get('excluded')
    if isinstance(excluded,list) and excluded and all(isinstance(v,dict) for v in excluded):
        # Rich GV-only exclusion metadata is a schema variant, never a scope waiver.
        records=copy.deepcopy(excluded);normalized=[]
        for item in records:
            locators=item.get('sourceRefs');pages=item.get('pages');reason=item.get('reason')
            import re
            if row.get('explicit_homework_scope','').strip() and isinstance(reason,str) and 'ngoài phạm vi' in reason.lower():
                p.require(isinstance(item.get('label'),str) and item['label'].strip() and isinstance(pages,list) and pages and all(type(v) is int and 1<=v<=page_count for v in pages),'Loại trừ ngoài phạm vi Sheet thiếu nhãn/trang thật')
                p.require(locators is None or isinstance(locators,list) and all(isinstance(v,str) and v.strip() for v in locators),'Locator loại trừ ngoài phạm vi sai kiểu')
                p.require(not set(locators or []).intersection(result.get('inventory',[])),'Loại trừ trùng câu HS đã chọn')
                # A selected and an excluded question can share a page. The
                # independent source coverage check still verifies exact scope.
                normalized.append(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True));continue
            theory=(isinstance(item.get('label'),str) and re.fullmatch(r'(?i)[IVX]+\.\s*LÝ THUYẾT',item['label'].strip()) and not locators and isinstance(reason,str) and 'không có câu hỏi' in reason.lower())
            if theory:
                selected_pages={page for section in sections if isinstance(section,dict) for page in section.get('pages',[]) if type(page) is int}
                p.require(isinstance(pages,list) and pages and all(type(v) is int and 1<=v<=page_count for v in pages) and not set(pages).intersection(selected_pages),'Trang lý thuyết loại trừ trùng trang câu hỏi hoặc không hợp lệ')
                p.require(not any(ref.startswith(item['label'].strip()+' ') for ref in result.get('inventory',[])),'Lý thuyết loại trừ chứa câu đã chọn')
                normalized.append(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True));continue
            p.require(item.get('document')=='gv' and isinstance(locators,list) and locators and all(isinstance(v,str) and v.strip() for v in locators) and isinstance(pages,list) and pages and all(type(v) is int and v>0 for v in pages) and isinstance(reason,str) and reason.strip(),'Loại trừ có cấu trúc không đủ căn cứ GV')
            p.require(not set(locators).intersection(result.get('inventory',[])),'Loại trừ trùng câu HS đã chọn')
            normalized.append(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
        selected['excludedRecords']=records
        selected['excluded']=excluded=normalized
    p.require(isinstance(sections,list) and sections and isinstance(excluded,list) and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in excluded),'Phạm vi thiếu phần/trang hoặc danh sách loại trừ')
    refs=[]
    for section in sections:
        p.require(isinstance(section,dict) and isinstance(section.get('label'),str) and section['label'].strip(),'Phạm vi thiếu tên phần')
        pages=section.get('pages');locators=section.get('sourceRefs')
        p.require(isinstance(pages,list) and pages and all(type(v) is int and 1<=v<=page_count for v in pages),'Phạm vi trỏ trang HS không có thật')
        p.require(isinstance(locators,list) and locators and all(isinstance(v,str) and v for v in locators),'Phạm vi thiếu locator câu')
        refs.extend(locators)
    p.require(len(refs)==len(set(refs)) and set(refs)==set(result.get('inventory',[])),'Phạm vi và inventory lệch nhau')
    result.setdefault('errata',[]).append({'type':'scope-selection','sourceRef':refs[0],'original':'Phạm vi từ cột Sheet' if row.get('explicit_homework_scope') else 'Ô Phạm vi BTVN trống/không có cột','corrected':selected['text'],'reason':'Theo phạm vi đã ghi trong Sheet; ô trống thì làm hết đề theo lệnh anh Thành 17/10, không hỏi lại','verification':json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False)})
    return result

def reconstruct_missing_selection(extracted,page_count):
    """Recover missing locator lists only from a complete, bijective transcription."""
    result=copy.deepcopy(extracted);selected=result.get('scopeSelection')
    if not isinstance(selected,dict):return result
    sections=selected.get('sections')
    if not isinstance(sections,list) or not sections or all(isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('sourceRefs') for x in sections):return result
    questions=result.get('questions',[])+result.get('manualQuestions',[]);refs=[q.get('sourceRef') for q in questions];inv=result.get('inventory')
    if result.get('certain') is not True or result.get('coverage_complete') is not True or not refs or len(refs)!=len(set(refs)) or not isinstance(inv,list) or set(refs)!=set(inv):return result
    recovered=[]
    for ref in inv:
        q=next(q for q in questions if q['sourceRef']==ref);crops=q.get('questionCrops')
        if not isinstance(crops,list) or not crops:return result
        pages=sorted(set(c.get('page') for c in crops if isinstance(c,dict) and type(c.get('page')) is int))
        if not pages or any(not 1<=page<=page_count for page in pages):return result
        recovered.append({'label':ref,'pages':pages,'sourceRefs':[ref]})
    selected['sectionsBeforeLocatorReconstruction']=copy.deepcopy(sections)
    selected['sections']=recovered
    selected['locatorReconstruction']='Exact sourceRef and source-page bijection from complete questions/manualQuestions; no change to inventory, scope text or exclusions. Still requires independent full-source coverage.'
    return result
